{"actions":[{"type":"success_contract","objective":"Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background so that telnet 127.0.0.1 6665 reaches a login prompt, and leave it running.","required_artifacts":["A running QEMU process using /app/alpine.iso","A reachable localhost TCP service on port 6665"],"required_behaviors":["QEMU starts in the background","Port 6665 accepts telnet connections","Connection shows a login prompt"],"known_invalid_patterns":["Only verifying the ISO file exists","Only checking QEMU binary presence","Only producing non-empty command output","Only compiling or smoke-testing without confirming telnet login prompt"],"verification_plan":["Locate the ISO and determine an appropriate QEMU invocation","Launch QEMU detached/backgrounded with host port 6665 forwarded to guest console/login service","Probe localhost:6665 until the login prompt is observed"],"finalization_evidence_required":["Receipt-backed evidence of the QEMU launch command and process/backgrounding","Receipt-backed evidence that localhost:6665 is reachable","Receipt-backed evidence that telnet to 127.0.0.1 6665 shows a login prompt"],"notes":["Preserve the original request over any derived state conflicts."]},{"type":"raw_bash","command":"set -euo pipefail\nfind /app -maxdepth 2 -type f \\( -name 'alpine.iso' -o -name '*.iso' \\) -printf '%p\\n' | sort","timeout_seconds":30,"capture_receipt":true}]}
